{
  "design": "ExperimentPanel 是嵌入现有 Run 页上部的紧凑工作流面板，不新增导航页。构造时创建 action_requested=Signal(str) 与当前按钮（inspect/validate/initialize/generate/run/evaluate/export/cancel）。浅层使用 QGridLayout 组织按钮，小屏时自动换行。状态区展示 revision、fingerprint 缩略、最近 run_id、总状态、四层独立验证（fields/initialization/execution/physics），每层用独立 label 显示 token 状态与 detail，不推断物理通过。历史区用 QTableWidget 显示与当前状态不同的历史记录，保留失败与陈旧记录；set_state 全量替换旧表，无记录时清空。导出按钮的 tooltip/说明通过 ui_text 展示，明确说明导出配置、资源与证据，不含 C++ 工程、密钥、机器设置。所有人类文本经 ui_text 获取并可在 retranslate_ui() 中重设；按钮使用稳定 action token 作为 objectName 和信号参数。set_busy(bool) 禁用除 cancel 外全部动作，cancel 始终可用。禁止持有项目/runner 引用，禁止新建 QProcess，不依赖时间戳，不自行判断成功。按钮有键盘焦点与可选中文本，主题用原生 palette，不硬编码颜色。",
  "source": "from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QAbstractItemView,
    QGridLayout,
    QGroupBox,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QSizePolicy,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from g4usim_gui.core.i18n import ui_text


ACTION_TOKENS: tuple[str, ...] = (
    "inspect",
    "validate",
    "initialize",
    "generate",
    "run",
    "evaluate",
    "export",
)
LEVEL_TOKENS: tuple[str, ...] = (
    "fields",
    "initialization",
    "execution",
    "physics",
)
VALID_LEVEL_STATUS_TOKENS = (
    "unverified",
    "passed",
    "failed",
    "stale",
    "unobserved",
    "cancelled",
)


class ExperimentPanel(QWidget):
    """K1 experiment workflow panel.

    The parent controller owns all project/runner state. This widget only
    emits stable action tokens and renders the provided snapshot.
    """

    action_requested = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._busy = False
        self._actions: Dict[str, QPushButton] = {}
        self._level_labels: Dict[str, QLabel] = {}
        self._state: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._history_items: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self._build_ui()
        self.retranslate_ui()
        self._apply_busy(self._busy)
        self._render_state()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ UI
    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        root.setSpacing(6)

        self._summary_group = QGroupBox(self)
        summary_layout = QVBoxLayout(self._summary_group)
        summary_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        summary_layout.setSpacing(4)

        self._summary_label = QLabel(self._summary_group)
        self._summary_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._summary_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextSelectableByMouse | Qt.TextSelectableByKeyboard)
        self._summary_label.setFocusPolicy(Qt.StrongFocus)
        summary_layout.addWidget(self._summary_label)

        self._levels_group = QGroupBox(self._summary_group)
        levels_layout = QGridLayout(self._levels_group)
        levels_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        levels_layout.setHorizontalSpacing(8)
        levels_layout.setVerticalSpacing(4)
        for row, level in enumerate(LEVEL_TOKENS):
            name_label = QLabel(self._levels_group)
            name_label.setObjectName(f"level_name_{level}")
            name_label.setFocusPolicy(Qt.StrongFocus)
            name_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextSelectableByMouse | Qt.TextSelectableByKeyboard)
            value_label = QLabel(self._levels_group)
            value_label.setObjectName(f"level_value_{level}")
            value_label.setWordWrap(True)
            value_label.setFocusPolicy(Qt.StrongFocus)
            value_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextSelectableByMouse | Qt.TextSelectableByKeyboard)
            levels_layout.addWidget(name_label, row, 0)
            levels_layout.addWidget(value_label, row, 1)
            levels_layout.setColumnStretch(1, 1)
            self._level_labels[level] = value_label
        summary_layout.addWidget(self._levels_group)

        self._history_group = QGroupBox(self)
        history_layout = QVBoxLayout(self._history_group)
        history_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        history_layout.setSpacing(4)

        self._history_table = QTableWidget(0, 3, self._history_group)
        self._history_table.setObjectName("experiment_history_table")
        self._history_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.NoEditTriggers)
        self._history_table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectRows)
        self._history_table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SingleSelection)
        self._history_table.setAlternatingRowColors(False)
        self._history_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        self._history_table.setFocusPolicy(Qt.StrongFocus)
        self._history_table.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Preferred)
        history_layout.addWidget(self._history_table)

        self._export_note_label = QLabel(self._history_group)
        self._export_note_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self._export_note_label.setFocusPolicy(Qt.StrongFocus)
        self._export_note_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextSelectableByMouse | Qt.TextSelectableByKeyboard)
        history_layout.addWidget(self._export_note_label)

        self._actions_group = QGroupBox(self)
        actions_layout = QGridLayout(self._actions_group)
        actions_layout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        actions_layout.setHorizontalSpacing(6)
        actions_layout.setVerticalSpacing(4)

        for token in ACTION_TOKENS:
            button = QPushButton(self._actions_group)
            button.setObjectName(f"action_{token}")
            button.setFocusPolicy(Qt.StrongFocus)
            button.clicked.connect(lambda _checked=False, t=token: self._emit_action(t))
            self._actions[token] = button

        self._cancel_button = QPushButton(self._actions_group)
        self._cancel_button.setObjectName("action_cancel")
        self._cancel_button.setFocusPolicy(Qt.StrongFocus)
        self._cancel_button.clicked.connect(lambda _checked=False: self._emit_action("cancel"))

        self._reflow_actions(actions_layout)

        root.addWidget(self._summary_group)
        root.addWidget(self._history_group)
        root.addWidget(self._actions_group)
        root.addStretch(1)

        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Preferred)

    def _reflow_actions(self, layout: QGridLayout) -> None:
        # Clear and re-add in compact rows; safe at runtime for small screens.
        while layout.count():
            item = layout.takeAt(0)
            widget = item.widget()
            if widget is not None:
                widget.setParent(self._actions_group)

        tokens = list(ACTION_TOKENS)
        columns = 3
        for index, token in enumerate(tokens):
            layout.addWidget(self._actions[token], index // columns, index % columns)
        cancel_row = (len(tokens) + columns - 1) // columns
        layout.addWidget(self._cancel_button, cancel_row, 0, 1, columns)
        for col in range(columns):
            layout.setColumnStretch(col, 1)

    def _emit_action(self, token: str) -> None:
        if self._busy and token != "cancel":
            return
        self.action_requested.emit(token)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------- i18n
    def retranslate_ui(self) -> None:
        self._summary_group.setTitle(ui_text("experiment.summary.title", "实验快照"))
        self._levels_group.setTitle(ui_text("experiment.levels.title", "四层验证"))
        self._history_group.setTitle(ui_text("experiment.history.title", "验证历史"))
        self._actions_group.setTitle(ui_text("experiment.actions.title", "工作流操作"))

        for token in ACTION_TOKENS:
            self._actions[token].setText(ui_text(f"experiment.action.{token}", token))
            self._actions[token].setToolTip(
                ui_text(f"experiment.action.{token}.tooltip", token)
            )
        self._cancel_button.setText(ui_text("experiment.action.cancel", "取消"))
        self._cancel_button.setToolTip(
            ui_text("experiment.action.cancel.tooltip", "取消当前操作")
        )

        self._history_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            [
                ui_text("experiment.history.column.level", "层级"),
                ui_text("experiment.history.column.status", "状态"),
                ui_text("experiment.history.column.record", "记录"),
            ]
        )
        self._export_note_label.setText(
            ui_text(
                "experiment.export.note",
                "导出仅包含配置、资源与证据；不包含 C++ 工程、密钥或机器设置。",
            )
        )
        self._render_levels()
        self._render_summary()
        self._render_history()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------- state
    def set_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        self._busy = bool(busy)
        self._apply_busy(self._busy)

    def _apply_busy(self, busy: bool) -> None:
        for token, button in self._actions.items():
            button.setEnabled(not busy)
        self._cancel_button.setEnabled(True)

    def set_state(self, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self._state = dict(data) if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
        history = self._state.get("history", [])
        self._history_items = (
            [dict(item) for item in history if isinstance(item, dict)]
            if isinstance(history, list)
            else []
        )
        self._render_summary()
        self._render_levels()
        self._render_history()

    def _render_summary(self) -> None:
        revision = self._state.get("revision")
        fingerprint = self._state.get("fingerprint")
        run_id = self._state.get("run_id")
        status = self._state.get("status")

        revision_text = self._display_value(revision)
        fingerprint_text = self._display_value(fingerprint)
        if isinstance(fingerprint, str) and len(fingerprint) > 12:
            fingerprint_text = fingerprint[:12] + "..."
        run_text = self._display_value(run_id)
        status_text = self._display_token(status, "experiment.status")

        self._summary_label.setText(
            ui_text(
                "experiment.summary.template",
                "快照 revision：{revision}    配置 hash：{fingerprint}    最近 run_id：{run_id}    总状态：{status}",
                revision=revision_text,
                fingerprint=fingerprint_text,
                run_id=run_text,
                status=status_text,
            )
        )

    def _render_levels(self) -> None:
        levels = self._state.get("levels", [])
        level_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        if isinstance(levels, list):
            for item in levels:
                if isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("level"), str):
                    level_map[item["level"]] = item

        for level in LEVEL_TOKENS:
            value_label = self._level_labels[level]
            level_name = ui_text(f"experiment.level.{level}", level)
            entry = level_map.get(level)
            if entry is None:
                status_token = "unverified"
                detail = ""
            else:
                status_token = entry.get("status", "unobserved")
                if status_token not in VALID_LEVEL_STATUS_TOKENS:
                    status_token = "unobserved"
                detail = entry.get("detail", "")
                if detail is None:
                    detail = ""
                if not isinstance(detail, str):
                    detail = str(detail)
            status_text = ui_text(f"experiment.level_status.{status_token}", status_token)
            if detail:
                value_label.setText(f"{status_text} — {detail}")
            else:
                value_label.setText(status_text)
            # Keep stable accessible name per level for screen readers.
            value_label.setAccessibleName(
                ui_text(
                    "experiment.level.accessible",
                    "{level}：{status}",
                    level=level_name,
                    status=status_text,
                )
            )

    def _render_history(self) -> None:
        table = self._history_table
        table.setRowCount(0)

        current_level_status: Dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
        levels = self._state.get("levels", [])
        if isinstance(levels, list):
            for item in levels:
                if isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("level"), str):
                    level = item["level"]
                    status = item.get("status", "")
                    if not isinstance(status, str):
                        status = str(status)
                    current_level_status[level] = (status, "")

        for row_data in self._history_items:
            level = row_data.get("level", "")
            status = row_data.get("status", "")
            record_id = row_data.get("record_id", "")
            if not isinstance(level, str):
                level = str(level)
            if not isinstance(status, str):
                status = str(status)
            if not isinstance(record_id, str):
                record_id = str(record_id)

            current = current_level_status.get(level)
            if current is not None and current[0] == status and not record_id:
                # Still show record-bearing entries; only skip fully empty matches.
                continue

            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            level_item = QTableWidgetItem(ui_text(f"experiment.level.{level}", level))
            status_item = QTableWidgetItem(
                ui_text(f"experiment.level_status.{status}", status)
            )
            record_item = QTableWidgetItem(record_id)
            level_item.setFlags(Qt.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemIsSelectable)
            status_item.setFlags(Qt.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemIsSelectable)
            record_item.setFlags(Qt.ItemIsEnabled | Qt.ItemIsSelectable)
            table.setItem(row, 0, level_item)
            table.setItem(row, 1, status_item)
            table.setItem(row, 2, record_item)

        table.resizeColumnsToContents()
        table.setMinimumHeight(min(180, 28 * max(1, table.rowCount() + 1)))

    @staticmethod
    def _display_value(value: Any) -> str:
        if value is None or value == "":
            return ui_text("experiment.value.empty", "—")
        return str(value)

    def _display_token(self, value: Any, prefix: str) -> str:
        if value is None or value == "":
            return ui_text("experiment.value.empty", "—")
        token = str(value)
        return ui_text(f"{prefix}.{token}", token)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ Qt hooks
    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - Qt API
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        compact = self.width() < 560
        group_visible = not compact
        self._levels_group.setVisible(group_visible)
        self._history_group.setMinimumHeight(0 if compact else 160)
        self._export_note_label.setVisible(not compact)
",
  "review_cases": [
    "观察 set_busy(True) 时除 cancel 外所有动作按钮被禁用，cancel 仍可点击并发出 action_requested('cancel')；set_busy(False) 后恢复。",
    "验证按钮发出的信号参数严格为 inspect/validate/initialize/generate/run/evaluate/export/cancel 稳定 token，而非本地化文本。",
    "验证 set_state 传入 levels 缺失或为空列表时，fields/initialization/execution/physics 四层分别显示“未验证”而不是推断通过。",
    "验证某一层 status 为 passed 时，不会连带把其他层显示为 passed；特别是 execution 通过不得推断 physics 通过。",
    "验证 levels 中出现未知 status token 时回退为“未观测”，不显示原始英文 token。",
    "验证 history 表在 set_state 后全量替换；新 state 的 history 为空时表格清空为 0 行。",
    "验证 history 中同一层级与当前状态相同且无 record_id 的记录不重复展示；历史失败与陈旧记录保留。",
    "验证 fingerprint 超过 12 个字符时缩略为前 12 个字符加省略号，revision 与 run_id 完整显示。",
    "验证 export 按钮的 tooltip 与说明文本明确声明仅导出配置、资源与证据，不含 C++ 工程、密钥或机器设置。",
    "验证 retranslate_ui() 在语言切换（父调用）后更新所有 group 标题、按钮文字、层级名称、状态文字、历史表头与摘要模板。",
    "验证窗口宽度缩小到 560 以下时，层级详情表与导出说明隐藏，历史表最小高度下降，避免大面积占用日志区；恢复宽度后重新显示。",
    "验证所有标签和表格文字可被鼠标与键盘选中，按钮与表格可获得键盘焦点，Tab 顺序合理。",
    "验证面板不持有 project/runner 引用，不新建 QProcess，不自行判断成功，不依赖时间戳。",
    "验证主题随原生 palette 变化（如切换系统明暗模式），无硬编码颜色。",
    "验证 set_state 传入非 dict 或 history 非列表时面板不崩溃，按空状态渲染。"
  ]
}
